# Chunk C0: Scaffolding, CI, traceability

Paste everything between the two `---` lines into Claude Code, run from your local clone of `ironfis1/cpanel-mail-mcp` with `main` pulled.

---

You are building chunk C0 of cpanel-mail-mcp, a Cloudflare Worker remote MCP server that gives Claude IMAP access to Scott's three cPanel business mailboxes. Read `docs/spec.md` (tag `spec-v1.4`), `docs/build/traceability.md`, `docs/prerequisites.md` and `docs/build/spec-questions.md` before writing code.

## Goal

Set up the project skeleton, test tooling, CI and the traceability check. No product behavior.

## Rules for this chunk (read first)

1. Build to `docs/spec.md` at git tag `spec-v1.4`. Do not edit `docs/spec.md`, `docs/rule-base.md`, `docs/ambiguity-log.md` or `docs/design.md`.
2. Implement only the requirements listed under "In scope". Do not add behavior the spec does not state, even if it seems obviously useful.
3. If a requirement is unclear, contradicts another, or needs a decision the spec does not make: do not decide it. Add an entry to `docs/build/spec-questions.md` (format below), skip that item, finish the rest, and list the question in the PR. Scott resolves it and, if needed, the spec gets a version bump.
4. Every automated test's name starts with the REQ IDs it verifies, for example `REQ-4-7 REQ-4-8: greeting times out after 5 s`.
5. Fill the "Verified by" column of `docs/build/traceability.md` for every in-scope row (test file and test name, or the manual check to perform). Set Status to `built` for automated rows that pass, or `needs Scott` for manual rows.
6. No secrets in the repo, logs, test output or PR. Passwords are entered by Scott with `wrangler secret put` only. Never print a secret value.
7. Work on branch `chunk/C0`. Open a pull request titled `C0: Scaffolding, CI, traceability`. Do not merge it. Stop after opening the PR.
8. The PR description contains: in-scope REQs and their status, the exact commands you ran with their pass/fail results, anything deferred and why, and any spec questions raised.

Spec question format (append to `docs/build/spec-questions.md`):

```
## Q<n> (C0)
REQ: <id(s)>
Question: <what is unclear>
Options: <2 or 3 readings>
Blocking: <yes/no; what is skipped until answered>
Resolution:
```

## Deliverables

- `src/` and `test/` layout for a Cloudflare Worker (ES modules). Keep `spike/` untouched; it is removed in C1.
- `wrangler.toml` with two environments: `staging` (Worker `cpanel-mail-mcp-staging`, test mailboxes only: mcptest@reasinger.net on server128.web-hosting.com and mcptest@yourcigardenindy.com on server223.web-hosting.com, see `docs/prerequisites.md`) and `production` (Worker `cpanel-mail-mcp`, the three live accounts, deployed only from a tag). Both in the scott@reasinger.net Cloudflare account (subdomain reasinger-ops).
- Unit test runner using `node --test` (no extra framework unless the spec requires it).
- `scripts/trace.mjs`: parses every `**REQ-x-y**` in `docs/spec.md`, parses test names in `test/`, reads `docs/build/traceability.md`, and prints per chunk: REQs, covered, uncovered. Flag `--chunk Cn --strict` exits non-zero if any Cn row is uncovered or blank.
- GitHub Actions: on every PR run unit tests and `trace.mjs`; on push to main (and on PRs when the secrets exist) deploy staging and run the integration suite (`test/integration/`). Integration jobs skip cleanly with a clear message when `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` is absent.
- Integration test harness that calls the staging Worker over HTTPS. Staging uses a temporary bearer token secret `STAGING_TOKEN` until C6 adds OAuth; production never accepts it.
- README stub: how to run tests, deploy staging, and set secrets.

## Required tests

- A smoke unit test proving the runner works.
- `trace.mjs` self-test: run against the real spec and confirm it finds exactly 276 REQs.

## Success criteria (all must hold before the PR is ready)

- CI green on the PR.
- `node scripts/trace.mjs` lists 276 REQs and the C0 rows are filled.
- `wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run` succeeds.
- `node scripts/trace.mjs` runs and reports the C0 rows filled.
- No new spec questions left unlisted in the PR.

Note on REQ-14-1 ("one test per requirement"): some requirements are verified by a manual or document check rather than code (see the Method column in the traceability matrix). Treat each Method entry as that requirement's test. Do not invent code tests for them.

## Gate (not part of the Claude Code prompt)

1. Claude Code opens the PR and stops.
2. Scott tells Claude in claude.ai: "verify C0, PR #<n>". Claude independently reads the diff, re-runs the unit tests, reads CI results, checks every in-scope REQ against its test, and checks for behavior the spec does not state. Verdict: PASS, or FAIL with findings.
3. Scott reviews the verdict and the PR, does any "Scott" actions below, and merges or sends findings back to Claude Code.

Scott actions for this chunk:

- Create a Cloudflare API token (Workers Scripts: Edit, on the scott@reasinger.net account only). Add GitHub repo secrets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` and `STAGING_TOKEN` (the same value as the staging Worker secret).
- After the first staging deploy, set staging secrets with `wrangler secret put --env staging` for `STAGING_TOKEN` and the two test mailbox passwords (names chosen in this chunk, documented in the README).
